summary: Iter14 backend testing complete. Validated POST /api/fund-calls/regenerate-from-budget endpoint with 8 new tests (all pass) + regression on iter13 (15/15 still pass).
critical_code_review_comments: fund_calls.py is 428 lines - approaching the 700 line threshold but still manageable; consider splitting wizard logic (_generate_from_budget, ~170 LOC) into its own helper module if more endpoints are added.
regenerate_from_budget uses date string comparison via {$gte: start_date} - works because dates are stored in ISO YYYY-MM-DD lexical order. OK but worth a comment in code.

_generate_from_budget builds the per-call distribution by iterating budget_lines via list comprehension `next((l for l in lots if l['id'] == kl['lot_id']), None)` (O(n*m)) - acceptable for typical sizes but could become slow for ACPs with hundreds of lots and many keys; consider pre-indexing lots_by_id once.
Reserve fund label fallback to 'Tantiemes' even when no distribution key is given - cosmetic only, no functional impact.
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures auto-create and cleanup: TEST_iter14_owner user, TEST_iter14_RegenBudget approved budget, TEST_iter14_RegressGen approved budget, plus all transient fund_calls linked to these budgets. All cleaned up after tests via module/class teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter14 endpoint /api/fund-calls/regenerate-from-budget fully covered. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter14_regenerate_from_budget.py covers: 404 (missing budget), 400 (draft budget), response shape (calls/summary/persisted/created_ids/deleted_count/preserved_count), preservation of paid calls (mark-paid on owner -> preserved=1, deleted=3), date-window logic (calls before start_date untouched), idempotence (2 successive runs delete what previous run created), RBAC 403 for owners, regression on generate-from-budget that lines+reserve_amount+budget_id are persisted. Re-run with `pytest backend/tests/test_iter14_regenerate_from_budget.py -v`.
